answer_text: All the public evidence says no. Microsoft says it was a technical failure, and the US government said on Nov 18 that the outage was not a cyberattack.

question_text: Was there a global Microsoft 365 outage on Nov 12 to 13?
answer_text: Yes, about 24 hours, per Microsoft's own report.
label: Confirmed

question_text: What caused it, according to Microsoft?
answer_text: A latent defect from a July update, extra load from a Teams failover, and reduced capacity, all at once.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Was it caused by AI-written code or AI agents?
answer_text: Microsoft says no. No one else has addressed it.
label: Rumor

question_text: Was it part of a coordinated attack with the FAA and bank outages?
answer_text: The US government says the incidents are unrelated.
label: Debunked

question_text: Did criminals try to exploit it?
answer_text: Microsoft's security team says so: phishing emails posed as outage notices. That was separate from the cause.
label: Reported

question_text: Was there a major Azure outage on Nov 18?
answer_text: We found none. Azure's status page showed no active events, and no outlet we found reported one.
label: Not established
